description: A directed anatomical subtype relationship, from a more specific Anatomy term (child) to a more general term (parent). A term may have multiple parents. Source support on an edge can also reflect anatomical containment rather than subtype alone; the edge label does not necessarily distinguish the current relationship asserted by each source.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: Sources supporting a relationship between the anatomical endpoints. Entries include "uberon" and "HOMBA"; source support can refer to either a subtype or a containment assertion.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Timestamp of the edge’s creation or a documented change to its source support.

source_contributions.scope: Relationships between non-obsolete terms in the multi-species Uberon basic anatomy ontology, with both endpoints present as Anatomy nodes.
source_contributions.description: Uberon supplies the anatomical class hierarchy through is_a assertions. Source support on this edge type may also reflect a part_of assertion for the same anatomical pair.

source_contributions.scope: Human brain anatomy represented by the Allen Institute Human Brain Atlas ontology (CCF-MAP release).
source_contributions.description: HOMBA support denotes a child-to-parent anatomical containment link in its hierarchy of regions, areas, layers and nuclei. On this edge type, HOMBA support should not be interpreted as a separate assertion that the child is a subtype of the parent.
